device_template.name: Pylontech CAN (BMS → inverter link, listen-only)
device_template.author: Stefan Maldaianu
device_template.description: The BMS → inverter link most batteries speak (Pylontech, Seplos V2/V3, JK and Daly in Pylontech mode), read LISTEN-ONLY with protocol can: the gateway never transmits on it. Standard 11-bit frames, little endian, 500 kbit/s, one frame set per second; the inverter answers 0x305 every second. Core frames (0x351, 0x355, 0x356, 0x359, 0x35C, 0x35E) follow Pylontech's document; rows marked UNVERIFIED come from one vendor's extension (Seplos 0x370/0x371, LuxPower capacity and cycles) and were checked only on the bench capture of a Seplos V2 bank talking to a Deye. Cell voltages and per-pack data stay on the inter-pack maps (seplos_bms_v3_rtu_tap, seplos_bms_v2); field names match them.
device_template.source_document: Pylontech 'PYLON CANBUS Protocol' V1.2 (2018-04-08); Seplos 'CANBUS Protocol V1.0' (2020, akkudoktor.net mirror); LuxPower 'Battery communication CAN Protocol' V04 (2024-03-13); cross-checked (no code taken) against esphome-yambms packages/yambms/yambms_canbus.yaml (Sleeper85, GPLv3); verified on a 2-minute candump of a Deye SG05LP1 ↔ Seplos V2 bank (tests/fixtures/can/deye_seplos_v2_20261026.candump, listen-only, 2026-10-26).

realtime.description: informational: the BMS sends every frame once a second

notes.text: Listen-only: the gateway opens the CAN interface for reception and has no transmit path. Set the interface listen-only on the host too (ip link set can0 type can bitrate 500000 listen-only on).
Rows marked UNVERIFIED in their description come from one vendor's extension and were checked only on a Seplos V2 bank; a real Pylontech or another BMS may fill those bytes differently or not at all.
inverter_keepalive is the inverter's 0x305 frame: always 0; when it goes stale the inverter has stopped talking.

registers.name: inverter_keepalive
registers.label: Inverter keepalive (0x305)
registers.description: Sent by the inverter every second (8 zero bytes). Its value carries nothing; its freshness says the inverter is talking on the link. Source: Pylontech CANBUS V1.2; Seplos CANBUS V1.0; LuxPower CAN V04; bench capture 2026-10-26 (Deye + Seplos V2).

registers.name: charge_voltage_limit
registers.label: Charge voltage limit (CVL)
registers.description: Source: Pylontech CANBUS V1.2; Seplos CANBUS V1.0; LuxPower CAN V04; bench capture 2026-10-26 (Deye + Seplos V2).

registers.name: charge_current_limit
registers.label: Charge current limit (CCL)
registers.description: Source: Pylontech CANBUS V1.2; Seplos CANBUS V1.0; LuxPower CAN V04; bench capture 2026-10-26 (Deye + Seplos V2).

registers.name: discharge_current_limit
registers.label: Discharge current limit (DCL)
registers.description: Source: Pylontech CANBUS V1.2; Seplos CANBUS V1.0; LuxPower CAN V04; bench capture 2026-10-26 (Deye + Seplos V2).

registers.name: discharge_voltage_limit
registers.label: Discharge voltage limit (DVL)
registers.description: UNVERIFIED against Pylontech: bytes 6-7 are empty in Pylontech V1.2; Seplos, LuxPower and Victron fill them with the discharge cut-off voltage. Source: Seplos CANBUS V1.0; LuxPower CAN V04; bench capture 2026-10-26 (Deye + Seplos V2).

registers.name: soc
registers.label: State of charge
registers.description: Source: Pylontech CANBUS V1.2; Seplos CANBUS V1.0; LuxPower CAN V04; bench capture 2026-10-26 (Deye + Seplos V2).

registers.name: soh
registers.label: State of health
registers.description: Source: Pylontech CANBUS V1.2; Seplos CANBUS V1.0; LuxPower CAN V04; bench capture 2026-10-26 (Deye + Seplos V2).

registers.name: pack_voltage
registers.label: Battery voltage
registers.description: Source: Pylontech CANBUS V1.2; Seplos CANBUS V1.0; LuxPower CAN V04; bench capture 2026-10-26 (Deye + Seplos V2).

registers.name: battery_current
registers.label: Battery current (+ charging)
registers.description: Source: Pylontech CANBUS V1.2; Seplos CANBUS V1.0; LuxPower CAN V04; bench capture 2026-10-26 (Deye + Seplos V2).

registers.name: battery_temperature
registers.label: Battery temperature
registers.description: Pylontech: average cell temperature; LuxPower: max cell temperature (the bench Seplos sends the max, equal to 0x370's). Source: Pylontech CANBUS V1.2; Seplos CANBUS V1.0; LuxPower CAN V04; bench capture 2026-10-26 (Deye + Seplos V2).

registers.name: protection_flags
registers.label: Protection (0x359 bytes 0-1)
registers.description: Byte 1 bit 0 (charge over current) is bit 8 here; bit 11 is byte 1 bit 3. Source: Pylontech CANBUS V1.2; Seplos CANBUS V1.0; LuxPower CAN V04; bench capture 2026-10-26 (Deye + Seplos V2).

registers.name: alarm_flags
registers.label: Warnings (0x359 bytes 2-3)
registers.description: 'cell failure' (bit 12) is Seplos-only. Source: Pylontech CANBUS V1.2; Seplos CANBUS V1.0; LuxPower CAN V04; bench capture 2026-10-26 (Deye + Seplos V2).

registers.name: module_count
registers.label: Modules in parallel
registers.description: Source: Pylontech CANBUS V1.2; Seplos CANBUS V1.0; LuxPower CAN V04; bench capture 2026-10-26 (Deye + Seplos V2).

registers.name: total_capacity
registers.label: Battery capacity
registers.description: UNVERIFIED against Pylontech: Pylontech puts 'P','N' (0x50 0x4E) in bytes 5-6, Seplos V1.0 leaves them empty; LuxPower V04 defines the capacity in Ah. Reads 0 or 20048 on a real Pylontech. Source: LuxPower CAN V04; bench capture 2026-10-26 (Deye + Seplos V2). Not selected by default (add it from the catalog on a BMS that sends it).

registers.name: online_packs
registers.label: Packs online (DIP addresses)
registers.description: UNVERIFIED against Pylontech: Seplos V1.0 only (table 5). Source: Seplos CANBUS V1.0; bench capture 2026-10-26 (Deye + Seplos V2). Not selected by default (add it from the catalog on a BMS that sends it).

registers.name: full_charge_request
registers.label: Full charge request
registers.description: Source: Pylontech CANBUS V1.2; LuxPower CAN V04.

registers.name: force_charge_2
registers.label: Force charge request II
registers.description: LuxPower V04 swaps the names of bits 4 and 5 (bit 4 = request 1). Source: Pylontech CANBUS V1.2; Seplos CANBUS V1.0.

registers.name: force_charge_1
registers.label: Force charge request I
registers.description: Source: Pylontech CANBUS V1.2; Seplos CANBUS V1.0.

registers.name: discharge_enable
registers.label: Discharge enable
registers.description: Source: Pylontech CANBUS V1.2; Seplos CANBUS V1.0; LuxPower CAN V04; bench capture 2026-10-26 (Deye + Seplos V2).

registers.name: charge_enable
registers.label: Charge enable
registers.description: Source: Pylontech CANBUS V1.2; Seplos CANBUS V1.0; LuxPower CAN V04; bench capture 2026-10-26 (Deye + Seplos V2).

registers.name: cycles
registers.label: Cycle count
registers.description: UNVERIFIED against Pylontech: a LuxPower V04 field; empty in Pylontech V1.2 and Seplos V1.0. Source: LuxPower CAN V04; bench capture 2026-10-26 (Deye + Seplos V2). Not selected by default (add it from the catalog on a BMS that sends it).

registers.name: manufacturer
registers.label: Manufacturer
registers.description: ASCII, NUL/space padded ("PYLON", "SHEnergy" = Seplos). Source: Pylontech CANBUS V1.2; Seplos CANBUS V1.0; LuxPower CAN V04; bench capture 2026-10-26 (Deye + Seplos V2).

registers.name: max_cell_temp
registers.label: Highest cell temperature
registers.description: UNVERIFIED against Pylontech: Seplos extension. Source: Seplos CANBUS V1.0; bench capture 2026-10-26 (Deye + Seplos V2).

registers.name: min_cell_temp
registers.label: Lowest cell temperature
registers.description: UNVERIFIED against Pylontech: Seplos extension. Source: Seplos CANBUS V1.0; bench capture 2026-10-26 (Deye + Seplos V2).

registers.name: max_cell_voltage
registers.label: Highest cell voltage
registers.description: UNVERIFIED against Pylontech: Seplos extension; its document says 0.1 °C (a copy error) — the bench frames are millivolts (3289 = 3.289 V, equal to 0x355 bytes 4-5). Source: Seplos CANBUS V1.0; bench capture 2026-10-26 (Deye + Seplos V2).

registers.name: min_cell_voltage
registers.label: Lowest cell voltage
registers.description: UNVERIFIED against Pylontech: Seplos extension, millivolts (see max). Source: Seplos CANBUS V1.0; bench capture 2026-10-26 (Deye + Seplos V2).

registers.name: max_cell_temp_id
registers.label: Highest-temperature cell (id)
registers.description: UNVERIFIED against Pylontech: Seplos extension. Source: Seplos CANBUS V1.0; bench capture 2026-10-26 (Deye + Seplos V2).

registers.label: Lowest-temperature cell (id)
registers.description: UNVERIFIED against Pylontech: Seplos extension. Source: Seplos CANBUS V1.0; bench capture 2026-10-26 (Deye + Seplos V2).

registers.label: Highest-voltage cell (id)
registers.description: UNVERIFIED against Pylontech: Seplos extension. Source: Seplos CANBUS V1.0; bench capture 2026-10-26 (Deye + Seplos V2).
